access_code_scope_check.name: access_code_scope_check
access_code_scope_check.value: ("task_access_codes"."scope" = 'PLAY_AND_SUBMIT' and "task_access_codes"."session_id" is null) or ("task_access_codes"."scope" = 'SUBMIT_ONLY' and "task_access_codes"."session_id" is not null)

decision_check.name: decision_check
decision_check.value: ("admin_role_requests"."status" = 'PENDIENTE' and "admin_role_requests"."decided_at" is null and "admin_role_requests"."decided_by_account_id" is null) or ("admin_role_requests"."status" <> 'PENDIENTE' and "admin_role_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "admin_role_requests"."decided_by_account_id" is not null)

account_auth_check.name: account_auth_check
account_auth_check.value: ("user_accounts"."status" = 'PENDIENTE' and "user_accounts"."auth_user_id" is null) or ("user_accounts"."status" <> 'PENDIENTE' and "user_accounts"."auth_user_id" is not null)

assignment_state_check.name: assignment_state_check
assignment_state_check.value: ("task_assignments"."status" = 'OPEN' and "task_assignments"."cancelled_at" is null and "task_assignments"."cancelled_by" is null) or ("task_assignments"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "task_assignments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "task_assignments"."cancelled_by" is not null)

indicator_availability_check.name: indicator_availability_check
indicator_availability_check.value: ("calculated_indicators"."availability_status" = 'CALCULATED' and "calculated_indicators"."value" is not null and "calculated_indicators"."unavailability_reason" is null) or ("calculated_indicators"."availability_status" = 'NOT_AVAILABLE' and "calculated_indicators"."value" is null and "calculated_indicators"."unavailability_reason" is not null)

game_session_attempt_check.name: game_session_attempt_check
game_session_attempt_check.value: ("task_sessions"."attempt_number" is null and "task_sessions"."started_at_server" is null and "task_sessions"."start_request_id" is null and "task_sessions"."upload_allowed_until" is null) or ("task_sessions"."attempt_number" between 1 and 10 and "task_sessions"."started_at_server" is not null and "task_sessions"."start_request_id" is not null and "task_sessions"."upload_allowed_until" is not null)

rule_approval_check.name: rule_approval_check
rule_approval_check.value: "indicator_rule_versions"."approval_status" in ('PROPOSED','APPROVED') and ("indicator_rule_versions"."approval_status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("indicator_rule_versions"."approved_at" is not null and "indicator_rule_versions"."approval_reference" is not null))

grant_scope_check.name: grant_scope_check
grant_scope_check.value: ("task_launch_grants"."scope" = 'START_SESSION' and "task_launch_grants"."submission_id" is null) or ("task_launch_grants"."scope" = 'RECOVER_SUBMISSION' and "task_launch_grants"."submission_id" is not null)

trial_check.name: trial_check
trial_check.value: "raw_events"."trial_number" > 0 and "raw_events"."spawned_at_ms" >= 0 and "raw_events"."closed_at_ms" >= "raw_events"."spawned_at_ms" and ("raw_events"."presented_at_ms" is null or "raw_events"."presented_at_ms" between "raw_events"."spawned_at_ms" and "raw_events"."closed_at_ms") and ("raw_events"."responded_at_ms" is null or ("raw_events"."presented_at_ms" is not null and "raw_events"."responded_at_ms" between "raw_events"."presented_at_ms" and "raw_events"."closed_at_ms"))

tasks_content_check.name: tasks_content_check
tasks_content_check.value: btrim("tasks"."title") <> '' and btrim("tasks"."description") <> '' and btrim("tasks"."purpose") <> '' and btrim("tasks"."pedagogical_notice") <> ''
